hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.command)||'';if(/\bgrep\b/.test(cmd)){process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason:'Use rg (ripgrep) instead of grep in this project - e.g. rg -n pattern path'}}));}}catch(e){}});"
